title: Bottom-page cycles-to-homology compatibility
statement: Let C be abelian, Y an EInt-indexed first-quadrant spectral object, E its standard E2 spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence], and m_(p,r) the explicit bottom-page maps [def-sc-spectral-object-bottom-page-map]. For every natural p and integer r>=2, the following equality of maps from the cycles at (p,0) on page r to H_Y^p(bottom,top) holds: iCycles_(p,0) followed by m_(p,r) equals homologyPi_(p,0), followed by the standard page homology isomorphism E_r.homology(p,0) ~= E_(r+1)^(p,0), followed by m_(p,r+1).

source.document: Stacks Project, Homology and Derived Categories; Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.SpectralObject
source.place: Tags 012K and 015N, expanded via Page.lean (ιE and map_ιE), Cycles.lean (fromOpcycles and opcyclesMap_fromOpcycles), SpectralSequence.lean (spectralSequence_iso and spectralSequenceHomologyData)

proof.text: Apply bottomPage_interval_compatibility: the page homology comparison commutes with the canonical finite-interval maps m_r to H^p(0,r-1). These m_r are exactly the first three factors in bottomPageMap.

First-quadrant vanishing makes the maps f:H^p(bottom,r-1)->H^p(0,r-1) and fprime:H^p(bottom,r)->H^p(0,r) invertible. Functor.map_comp gives f followed by g = gprime followed by fprime, and gprime followed by the map to (bottom,top) equals the direct map to (bottom,top). Cancel f to deduce g followed by inverse fprime and the map to the top equals inverse f and the direct map to the top. Postcompose the finite-interval equality with inverse fprime and the map to the top; unfold bottomPageMap and reassociate.

proof_origin.place: Finite-interval homology calculation, then Functor.map_comp and cancellation of first-quadrant isomorphisms

lean.statement:
theorem bottomPageMap_compatibility
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (Y : SpectralObject C EInt) [Y.IsFirstQuadrant]
    (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    (Y.E₂SpectralSequenceNat.page r hr).iCycles (p, 0) ≫ Y.bottomPageMap p r hr =
      (Y.E₂SpectralSequenceNat.page r hr).homologyπ (p, 0) ≫
        (Y.E₂SpectralSequenceNat.iso r (r + 1) (p, 0) rfl hr).hom ≫
          Y.bottomPageMap p (r + 1) (by omega)
